finalText:
It's building clean now, exit code 0 with 0 errors.

The screenful of warnings was mostly noise from the version bump — deprecation notices and progress lines. But two real bugs were hiding in there, both from an options shape change the bump introduced:

- `src/core/options.js` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. That threw on `undefined.toFixed()`.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js` treated an unset backoff flag as invalid and threw, instead of the old behavior of defaulting to off.

Fixed both to match the new shape. Build now finishes in 44.9s with 8 warnings, 0 errors.
